sources.provider: NOAA MRMS / NOAA Open Data Dissemination
sources.product: MultiSensor_QPE_01H_Pass2; compare Pass1 and a gauge-influence/quality layer
sources.space_time: approximately 1 km, rolling one-hour accumulation; multi-sensor blend updated hourly
sources.latency: product documents differ: public product descriptions list 60-minute Pass1 and 120-minute Pass2; NOAA product tables list hourly products/latencies differently. Measure valid-time-to-receipt latency prospectively.
sources.historical_archive: MRMS operational record dates to 2014; public AWS archive is documented from October 2020; earlier community archives are selective and have retention caveats. Full grid/hour completeness for the 2023+ MAUL1 evaluation was not audited.
sources.quality: qualified; radar and gauge blending, QC, version changes and gauge availability affect estimates; preserve product/version and quality fields
sources.aggregation: Use the upstream MAUL1 drainage polygon or explicitly documented subbasin polygons and area-weighted grid-cell accumulation, not the nearest grid cell. Geometry and grid intersection are not yet generated.
sources.cost: free public NOAA data; GitHub Actions can query recent files and retain only watershed aggregates
